description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Upton Stout is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Stout was limited in practice this week. His status remains uncertain heading into kickoff.
items.title: Upton Stout (shoulder/neck) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Austen Pleasants is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Pleasants is up in the air due to a knee injury.
items.title: Austen Pleasants (knee) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Siran Neal is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Neal continues to manage knee and foot injuries.
items.title: Siran Neal (knee/foot) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Greenlaw was limited in practice on Thursday. He appears to be trending in the right direction.
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (neck) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Watkins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Watkins is dealing with a groin injury. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.
items.title: Jordan Watkins (groin) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Evans returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He'll be a WR2 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tee Higgins (hamstring) did not practice on Friday and is questionable for Sunday against the Saints.
items.impact: Higgins was a surprise DNP on Friday, and his status for Sunday is now in doubt. He still has a chance to play, but fantasy managers will need to watch this closely. If Higgins is out, Andrei Iosivas and Dohnte Meyers could find some extra appeal, but Mike Gesicki would be a great start.
items.title: Tee Higgins (hamstring) DNP Friday, questionable for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is for Powers-Johnson. There should be an update on his status this weekend or early next week.
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (Achilles) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: David Njoku is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Njoku remains off the fantasy radar if he is healthy.
items.title: David Njoku (shoulder) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Mitchell was unable to practice with a knee injury. Kimani Vidal could see some more run behind Omarion Hampton.
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Justin Herbert has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Herbert was unable to clear concussion protocol. DJ Uiagalelei is expected to start in his place for the Chargers.
items.title: Justin Herbert (concussion) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mac Jones will start for the 49ers in Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Brock Purdy was ruled out after not practicing all week. Jones will be a mid-to-low-end QB2 for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.
items.title: Mac Jones to start for 49ers in Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brock Purdy has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Purdy was unable to practice all week after suffering an ankle injury last Sunday. It will be Mac Jones behind center for the 49ers.
items.title: Brock Purdy (ankle) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tetairoa McMillan returned to a limited practice on Friday.
items.impact: McMillan was back after he sat out of practice on Thursday. He is trending towards being good to go for Monday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.title: Tetairoa McMillan (foot) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Darren Waller was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Waller has logged back-to-back limited practices. He will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.
items.title: Darren Waller (knee) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Isaiah Williams is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Williams will be a WR4/WR5 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen McMillan was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: McMillan practiced in full on Thursday. He'll need to be monitored again on Saturday.
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brock Bowers has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Bowers did not practice on Friday after he was able to practice on Wednesday and Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) listed questionable for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Harrison will make his return as had been expected. He'll be a risky flex/WR4 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Boutte was unable to practice all week. He remains off the fantasy radar when healthy.
items.title: Kayshon Boutte (hip) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Derrick Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Henry should be in line for his usual workload in the Ravens backfield.
items.title: Derrick Henry (concussion) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zay Flowers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Flowers will be a full-go for the Ravens. He will remain a borderline WR1/WR2 with Jacoby Brissett behind center.
items.title: Zay Flowers (ankle) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashod Bateman is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Bateman hauled in a touchdown last week. He will remain an upside WR4 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Rashod Bateman (groin) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Titans.
items.impact: Meyers will figure to step into a bigger role with Parker Washington ruled out for the Jaguars.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) off injury report for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Treylon Burks is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Burks has struggled the past couple of weeks. He will be an upside WR4 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) off injury report for Week 12
